description: This file defines an interface 'MuteableConnectionLogger' that extends 'ConnectionLogger' and provides methods to mute, unmute, and check the mute status of a connection logger within the logging subsystem of the messaging service in the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: MuteableConnectionLogger
classes.description: An interface for a connection logger that supports muting and unmuting operations, extending the 'ConnectionLogger' interface.

methods.name: mute
methods.description: Mutes the logger so that subsequent messages are not stored.

methods.name: unmute
methods.description: Unmutes the logger so that messages are once again stored.

methods.name: isMuted
methods.description: Returns whether the logger is currently muted.
